mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 67 degrees, feeling like 69 degrees near Verona City Hall. The moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is updating residents on two major items. First, the Water Utility is working with HydroCorp to conduct cross connection surveys, so keep an eye on your mail for an appointment letter. Second, remember that a portion of Highway M will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for road improvements, so plan your detours via Old PB and Main Street accordingly.

There are plenty of ways to get involved today. You can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join the trivia night fun at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to the ART Bar Happy Hour at ART House 360 starting at 5 PM, or the Hop Haus trivia challenge at 6:30 PM.

In a report covering September 14 to September 28, we noted an incident on September 21 where a suspect was identified through surveillance video and cited for retail theft after taking candy from a retailer on East Verona Avenue.

If you are looking for a dessert, head over to Culver's to enjoy today's delicious flavor of the day, Double Strawberry. The restaurant is currently open and will remain serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
